tweets.author: Chandler Rome
tweets.html: The Astros won 3-2. They are 64-63.The bullpen threw 5.1 scoreless innings in relief of Ethan Pecko. Josh Hader stranded the tying run at third base. Christian Vázquez homered and Jose Altuve had a big double. The AL West lead is back to two games.

tweets.html: AJ Blubaugh just lowered his ERA to 3.35 in his 78th inning of the season. No major-league reliever has logged more. Kevin McGonigle is the AL Rookie of the Year, but it's hard to overstate how valuable Blubaugh has become to the Astros and how much he's made a name for himself

tweets.author: Chandler Rome
tweets.html: Ethan Pecko in his major-league debut: 3.2 IP, 3 H, 2 ER, 3 BB, 4 K, 89 pitches, 49 strikes, 39 swings, 11 whiffs, 85.1 mph average exit velocity. Pecko didn't have great command and operated without much feel of his four-seam fastball, but did well to limit damage.

tweets.author: Brian McTaggart
tweets.html: Ethan Pecko's MLB debut comes to an end after 89 pitches and 3 2/3 innings. He went two times through the Angels order and gave up three hits and three walks and struck out four. He's given up two runs and is responsible for the runner at second.
